City council tables vote on data center rezoning

By City Desk | July 9, 2026

The city council voted to table a rezoning request for a proposed data center on the industrial parcel near the rail yard, after members said they wanted more information about the water supply the facility would need during the summer months.

The applicant had asked for the land to be rezoned from light industrial to a technology district, a designation the city created last year. Opponents collected signatures on a petition asking the council to reject the request, and several spoke during the public comment period.

Council members said the item could return at a future meeting once staff completes a review of utility capacity. The planning department said a traffic study and a noise assessment are also still outstanding.

The developer did not say whether it would amend the application, and a spokesperson declined to comment after the meeting.
